entries.title: Learn-to-Play scope ends at an onboarding boundary
entries.summary: Use this guide for the first five scenarios and the mechanics it introduces. It explicitly points onward to a Rules Glossary/final rules, so do not treat the upload as the complete campaign reference.

source_locator.locator: Introduction; Final Rules; Introduction and final-rules sections

entries.title: A scenario round has four checkpoints
entries.summary: For each round, select two ability cards, reveal initiative, resolve character and monster turns in order, then perform end-of-round cleanup. Repeat until the scenario objective or loss condition resolves.

source_locator.locator: Playing the Game; p. 6: round structure

entries.title: One card sets initiative; both cards supply actions
entries.summary: Choose two cards privately. The initiative value on one controls ordering; on the character turn, take the top action from one card and the bottom action from the other, in either order.

entries.title: Initiative is a whole-round ordering tool
entries.summary: After reveal, resolve figures from low to high initiative, interleaving characters and monsters rather than finishing all characters first. Check the scenario’s stated monster initiative and exceptions before resolving a tie or special case.

source_locator.locator: Ordering of Initiative; Monster Turns; pp. 7, 10–11

entries.title: Exhaustion removes a character from this scenario
entries.summary: A character at zero hit points becomes exhausted and leaves the map for the rest of the scenario. If every character is exhausted, the scenario is lost; exhaustion does not erase the campaign character between scenarios.

entries.title: Short rests trade a random card for endurance
entries.summary: At round end, a character with at least two discarded ability cards may rest: shuffle the discard pile, lose one card to the lost pile, and return the remainder to hand. Lost cards stay unavailable for that scenario.

entries.title: Campaign progress is recorded after scenario resolution
entries.summary: A successful scenario can unlock the next location, while scenario completion sections record money, experience, perks, items, and other progression introduced by the guide. Save between scenarios; consult the scenario book for the actual objective and reward.
